lines.text: After six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a high mountain by themselves.
Jesus' clothes became radiantly white, and Elijah and Abraham appeared and talked with Him.
Peter offered to put up three shelters, because they were all so joyful.
A voice from a cloud said, "This is My beloved Son," and Jesus told them to tell no one.
Jesus said Elijah has indeed come, and that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected.
